events.title: Dave Stringer resigns as manager of 노리치 시티 after five seasons, with coach David Williams being put in temporary charge for the club's final game of the season.

리즈 유나이티드 finish their title winning campaign with a 1–0 home win over 노리치 시티. 맨체스터 유나이티드 finish second after beating 토트넘 홋스퍼 3–1, with 게리 리네커 scoring a consolation goal for the North London side to finish the season with 28 league goals. It is the last game to be played in front of the Stretford End terrace before it is replaced by an all-seater stand. 아스널's 이언 라이트 leapfrogs Lineker as the First Division's top scorer, with 29 goals, by scoring a hat-trick against 사우샘프턴 in a 5–1 win at Highbury, in the last game to be played in front of the existing North Bank. 루턴 타운's final game of the season ends in defeat by relegated 노츠 카운티, ending their 10-year stay in the top flight. 코번트리 시티 survive by two points despite losing to 애스턴 빌라. In his final game for 웨스트햄 유나이티드, Frank McAvennie scores a hat-trick for the relegated East London side in their 3–0 home win over 노팅엄 포리스트. 데이비드 화이트 scores a hat-trick for 맨체스터 시티 in their 5–2 away win over Oldham. 리버풀 finish sixth in the league – their lowest final position for 27 years – but maintain their record of finishing in the top eight every season since winning promotion in 1962. 미들즈브러 clinch the second promotion place in the Second Division, winning 2–1 at 울버햄프턴 원더러스. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 achieve survival with a 2–1 at 레스터 시티, who along with their local rivals 더비 카운티 qualify for the playoffs. Cambridge's hopes of a unique third successive promotion remain alive as they qualify for the playoffs by finishing fifth. 블랙번 로버스 seal the final playoff place with a 3–1 at Plymouth, who are relegated after six seasons in the Second Division. Oxford's survival is ensured by a 2–1 away win over Tranmere at Prenton Park , while Brighton are sent down by a 3–1 defeat at champions 입스위치 타운 and 포트 베일 go down in bottom place after losing 1–0 at home to Grimsby.
고든 스트라컨 announces his retirement from international action with Scotland.
퓌리아니 참사 — 바스티아와 마르세유의 프랑스컵 준결승을 앞두고 임시 관중석이 붕괴했다. 관중석 증설과 경기장 안전 문제가 참사로 이어졌다.

A provisional tribune crashes in the Stade Armand Cesari in 바스티아 , Corsica during the semi-final of the Coupe de France between 바스티아 SC and Olympique de 마르세유 . Eighteen people die, while 2.300 fans get injured.

It is announced that England will host the 1996 UEFA European Football Championships . Bobby Gould is sacked as manager of 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 after they just missed out on the Third Division play-offs in their first season at this level.
Defender Des Walker moves from 노팅엄 포리스트 to 삼프도리아 of Italy for £1.5million.

Phil Neal , the former 리버풀 captain, is sacked after more than six years as manager of 볼턴 원더러스. Neal, 41, oversaw Bolton's relegation to the Fourth Division in 1987 but won them promotion after just one season, and last season he took them to the brink of promotion to the Second Division. However, he could only manage them to 13th place in this season's Third Division. Two more Third Division clubs make managerial appointments on the same day, as Ossie Ardiles returns to management with 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, and Ivan Golac steps down as 토키 유나이티드 manager after failing to keep them in the division. With Wes Saunders declining the chance to return to the Torquay manager's job on a permanent basis, the club appoint another senior player, Paul Compton as manager.
리버풀 lift the FA Cup for the fifth time in their history thanks to a 2–0 win over 선덜랜드 at Wembley. The goals come from 마이클 토머스 and 이언 러시, who scores for a record fifth time in the final.
리버풀 wins 2–0 over 선덜랜드 to claim the FA Cup .
Mike Masters becomes the first American to score at Wembley, doing so for 콜체스터 유나이티드 in the F.A Trophy Final.
Former England manager 보비 롭슨 ends two years with PSV 에인트호번 in the Netherlands to manage 스포르팅 of Portugal .

Rob Jones pulls out of contention for a place in England's European Championship squad due to a shin splints injury. Peter Shreeves is dismissed as team manager of 토트넘 홋스퍼 after one disappointing season back at the helm.
그레이엄 테일러 announces England's 20-man squad for the European Championships.
포츠머스 accept a £700,000 offer from 리버풀 for defender John Beresford .
Having secured 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's survival in the Second Division, 케빈 키건 signs a three-year contract to become manager on a permanent basis.

올더숏 타운 are formed in place of the bankrupt 올더숏 FC, and are applying for a place in next season's Isthmian League Third Division. 블랙풀 become the second team to win promotion (토키 유나이티드 beating 블랙풀 5v4 on 31st May 1991 - previous season) on penalties when they defeat 스컨소프 유나이티드 4–3 on penalties after a 1–1 draw in the Fourth Division playoff final.

피터버러 유나이티드 win the Third Division playoff final with a 2–1 win over 스톡포트 카운티 to become founder members of the new Division One and reach the second tier of the English league for the first time in their 32 years as a Football League side.

블랙번 로버스 return to the top flight of English football after a 26-year exile after beating 레스터 시티 in the Second Division playoff final. The only goal of the game is a penalty by former 레스터 시티 striker Mike Newell . 리 딕슨 becomes the second right-back to pull out of the England squad, causing 그레이엄 테일러 to call upon the 레인저스 defender Gary Stevens .

Bobby Gould is appointed joint manager of 코번트리 시티 alongside Don Howe, who was his assistant when he managed 윔블던 to FA Cup glory in 1988 . 더비 카운티, who missed out on a place in the new Premier League after defeat in the playoffs, prepare for another promotion push by signing midfielder Mark Pembridge from 루턴 타운 for £1.25million. 토트넘 홋스퍼 announce that Doug Livermore will be taking charge of the first team from next season with 레이 클레먼스 as his assistant, while chief executive 테리 베너블스 will be involved in the coaching side of the club again.
브루스 리옥 returns to football as manager of 볼턴 원더러스.
